object.description: Steps: 1. Open data_extraction_rules.xml. 2. Read the cloud-backup section and the device-transfer section. 3. Open AndroidManifest.xml and read the dataExtractionRules attribute. Expected: The cloud-backup section and the device-transfer section each contain an exclude rule for the database domain, and the manifest references the file. A bmgr backup is not used, because allowBackup is false and a backup would be empty with or without the rule.
